item.title: Implement safe_extract.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request, verbatim: "Implement `safe_extract.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Goal: make safe_extract.py conform to SPEC.md in repo quality-safe-extract. Acceptance criteria: every API in SPEC.md kept with its documented signature and behaviour; every specified error type and boundary case handled explicitly; new focused tests covering those error and boundary cases in addition to the existing basic tests, all passing with the standard library only (no new dependencies); changes committed locally on the item's branch. Follow the repository's CLAUDE.md commandments: functions under 60 lines, meaningful assertions at boundaries, no silent failure, no try/except-pass.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged: the learned route's effort

model_reasons.build: Security-sensitive archive extraction (path traversal, symlinks); adaptive lead keeps context through fixes.

pr.body:
Approach: extract() validates root, entry shape, names (relative POSIX, no empty/./.. components, no backslash, colon or NUL, strict UTF-8), duplicates and file/directory collisions, and that every target and its ancestors are absent or real directories (lstat, so symlinks are rejected). Only then does it create parents and write each file with open(..., 'xb'). Unexpected I/O errors propagate.

Files: safe_extract.py, test_safe_extract.py.

Checks: python3 -m unittest test_safe_extract -> Ran 34 tests, OK.

Review: three whole-change reviews failed on one blocking issue (a root under a regular file raised NotADirectoryError instead of ValueError). Fixed in abf43f3 with a regression test. A delta reviewer read a4ced21..abf43f3 and passed the head.

Open follow-ups (non-blocking): ENAMETOOLONG from over-long components still propagates as OSError; symlinks above root are not checked (outside SPEC's below-root scope); the existing basic tests still use tempfile dir='.'; case-insensitive filesystem collisions are not checked; TOCTOU races are out of scope per SPEC.

Assumptions: list entries must be 2-tuples; names are encoded with strict UTF-8, which is stricter than surrogateescape.
pr.summary: Made extract(entries, root) work per SPEC.md. Now validates the whole batch and all target paths before creating anything; rejects bad input with ValueError. Before: NotImplementedError stub. Now: 34 tests cover error and boundary cases.
